title: A capability, not a project
sub: Film 1 of 3 of Governance on the map, the second series on data governance: governance lasts only as something the university always does, so it's drawn on the architecture map as a capability, coloured by evidence, with services people can ask for, each with a promise.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms, and on the land behind a dike in Holland, around 1300. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side, warm umber for the people of the past. Gold is governance's decisions; on the heat map, green runs in the work, amber is what people still have to remember, and red is what nobody does yet.
